title: 比特币仍低高点30%：塞勒却说牛市刚开始，200周均线成关键尺
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's get some more on strategy, joining us from DC Fintech Week at the World Bank for an exclusive interview.
segments.zh: 我们从世界银行DC金融科技周现场带来独家专访。

segments.en: This Michael Sailer found an executive chairman of strategy. It's the world's largest publicly traded Bitcoin accumulator.
segments.zh: 这位是塞勒，Strategy的执行主席，全球最大的公开交易比特币持有者。

segments.en: Michael always good to see you. Thanks so much for joining us.
segments.zh: Michael，很高兴见到你，感谢接受采访。

segments.en: Bitcoin had a great summer, still though, about 30% below last year's all-time highs.
segments.zh: 比特币今夏表现强劲，但仍比去年历史高点低约30%。

segments.en: What is your view on where Bitcoin goes from here?
segments.zh: 您认为比特币接下来会怎么走？

segments.en: When we think we're at the beginning of a bull market, we normally look at where Bitcoin is versus 200-week moving average.
segments.zh: 我们认为牛市刚开始，通常看比特币与200周均线的对比。

segments.en: We bounce slightly below it. Now we're moving up 25% premium.
segments.zh: 我们略低于均线反弹，现在正上涨至25%溢价。

segments.en: The headwinds were restrictive trade policy, restrictive foreign policy, restrictive currency, our monetary policy, and now we're rotating into some tailwinds.
segments.zh: 逆风来自限制性贸易政策、外交政策、货币和货币政策，现在正转向顺风。

segments.en: We've got a very favorable regulatory environment.
segments.zh: 我们拥有非常有利的监管环境。

segments.en: We've got banking adoption, accelerating. We've got tokenized securities in the digital asset space, accelerating.
segments.zh: 银行业采纳正在加速，数字资产领域的代币化证券也在加速。

segments.en: We've got the formation of and the strengthening of digital credit networks and of course banking credit coming online and all these things are very auspicious for the asset.
segments.zh: 数字信贷网络正在形成并强化，银行信贷也逐步上线，这些对资产而言都是积极信号。
